claim.claim-text: 1. A stent (2400) for a prosthetic heart valve (10), the stent comprising

- an outflow end (2402) and an inflow end (2404), - a plurality of struts forming outflow cells at the outflow end (2402) and inflow cells at the inflow end (2404), each outflow cell comprising an outflow free apex pointing in the direction of the outflow end (2402), wherein - the stent (2400) is made of a balloon expandable material, - the stent (2400) is formed without any struts that form free apexes that point in the direction of the outflow end (2402), except for the outflow free apexes, and - each of the outflow cells is formed by six or eight struts.
2. The stent according to claim 1, wherein the outflow free apex of a given outflow cell is formed by two adjacent struts of that outflow cell.
3. The stent according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the stent (2400) comprises 5, 6, or 7 rows of struts, each row of struts extending circumferentially along the stent (2400).
4. The stent according to at least one of the preceding claims, wherein the stent (2400) has a cylindrical shape.

5. The stent according to at least one of the preceding claims, wherein the balloon expandable material is configured to expand plastically wherein, preferably, the balloon expandable material is stainless steel.

6. The stent according to at least one of the preceding claims, comprising a plurality of fixed apexes (2410) pointing in the direction of the outflow end (2402), each fixed apex (2410) being formed by two struts (2412a, 2412b) in the same row of struts and at least a third strut (2412c) in an adjacent row of struts.
7. A prosthetic heart valve (10) comprising the stent (2400) according to at least one of the preceding claims and a leaflet assembly (14) mounted to the stent (2400).
8. The prosthetic heart valve according to claim 7, wherein the leaflet assembly (14) comprises three leaflets (34a, 34b, 34c) made of a flexible material.
9. The prosthetic heart valve according to claim 8, wherein the flexible material is a biological material or a bio-compatible synthetic material.

10. The prosthetic heart valve according to at least one of claims 7 to 9, wherein the leaflet assembly (14) includes an annular reinforcing skirt (42) that is secured to outer surfaces of inflow end portions of the leaflets (34a, 34b, 34c) at a suture line (44) adjacent an inflow end of the prosthetic heart valve (10).

11. The prosthetic heart valve according to at least one of claims 7 to 10, wherein the inflow end portion of the leaflet assembly (14) is secured to the stent (2400) by suturing the skirt (42) to struts of the stent (2400).
12. The prosthetic heart valve according to at least one of claims 7 to 11, wherein the leaflets (34a, 34b, 34c) extend the entire length or substantially the entire length of the stent (2400).

13. The prosthetic heart valve according to at least one of claims 7 to 12, wherein an outflow end portion of the leaflet assembly (14) is secured to the upper portion of the stent (2400) at three angularly spaced commissure attachments of the leaflets (34a, 34b, 34c).

14. The prosthetic heart valve according to at least one of claims 7 to 13, wherein the leaflet assembly (14) includes an inner reinforcing strip (46) that is secured to the inner surfaces of the inflow end portions (60) of the leaflets (34a, 34b, 34c).

a delivery apparatus that is configured to deliver a prosthetic heart valve (10) through a patient's vasculature and comprising an inflatable balloon; and the prosthetic heart valve (10) according to at least one of claims 7 to 14 crimped onto the inflatable balloon of the delivery apparatus.
